snippet.title: The Kepler Experiment, Survival Horror FPS – Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
The Kepler Experiment is an upcoming survival-horror first-person shooter made using the open-source Godot Engine.

Story

Adrift in space, with life support in your shuttle failing, you are rescued, just in time, by the XSS Kepler – a research vessel that went mysteriously missing many years ago. But celebration will have to come later, for you soon find yourself fighting off the horrifying creatures that now call the ship home and scavenging for supplies to stay alive.
